title: Investigate sqlite-vec distance metric and document findings
description: Check pyproject.toml for the declared sqlite-vec version. Confirm which distance metric (L2, cosine, inner product) is returned in the distance column for the vec0 virtual table at that version. Add a comment in memory.py documenting the metric name, value range, and direction (lower = more similar). Record whether pre-filtering by source is supported before ANN search at this version. This bead produces no user-visible behaviour change — only documentation and inline comments.
